title: Fix the Nested Grid Printer
description: The program should print a 3x3 grid of coordinate pairs, from (0,0) to (2,2). Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 3 rows of 3 coordinate pairs each.
actualProblem: The inner loop uses range(2), which only produces columns 0 and 1, so each row is missing its third coordinate pair.
explanation: For a 3x3 grid, both the outer and inner loop need range(3) so each dimension produces exactly three values: 0, 1, and 2.
